industry.why: Neutral, carried unchanged as a judgement on an absence. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): no source spoke to defence this week (the thematics and sectors reports both list it as unspoken), so the last demand read is the 9-Oct-26 one (DNB Carnegie and Barclays, 'stronger for longer', book-to-bill near three times) and it is two weeks old; against it Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: F now, D prior at industry level and F on both sectors, the second reading at F. Orders up, shares down, nothing new on either side: the row does not move on an absence. One live holding, Theon (4.05%), judged in component 4. Counter-case: a market with no settled view on an industry is one to Underweight until it settles, and two readings at F is the market's view. Moves to D on a third reading at F with no demand read in the sources.

sector.why: Neutral, carried unchanged as a judgement. Component 1 regime, 9-Oct-26 (late-cycle rates squeeze turning into a European credit-and-sovereign stress episode: hiking path re-marked up, credit joined rates, French spread 152 basis points, European breadth at three-year lows on all four averages, index 5.3% off its high, defensives turning over one and four weeks but unconfirmed, growth firm at the level; sources present 2026-W41): the same demand read and the same derating as the Primes, with the small names moving most (Theon minus 16 points relative over 30 days, Ovzon minus 16, Exosens minus 10, MilDef minus 8, on the turning note's falling side, still 21% to 35% above the market over twelve months); the Fragility axis at Double Underweight already scores their size and case risk, so the sector row carries no second penalty. One live holding, Theon (4.05%), judged in component 4. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-09 against 2026-08-07, not week on week: F now, D prior. Counter-case: domestic money has funded small defence names at a premium, and the turning note reads this as a transient demand-timing concern in a non-cyclical revenue line.

geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 and energy leading the week; Norway is where the energy hedge is listed (Equinor, Aker BP, Var Energi, Odfjell Drilling, Subsea 7, TGS in the Pool). Oslo's own performance was not re-read this week. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case: this double counts the Energy rows for most of the 46 Norwegian stocks; back to C if Brent falls under $85 or Oslo's leadership reverses for four weeks.
